trust_decision.summary: Remote-peer-supplied SCTP chunk lengths/counts are trusted to bound reads of the shared receive buffer; the SACK parser trusts numGapAckBlocks/numDuplicateTSNs and the WebRTC receive loop treats any non-ApplicationException parse failure as fatal to the association.

landing_point.why: Summary names 'SCTP SACK chunk parsing'; SctpSackChunk.ParseChunk is the only SACK parser.

fix_sites.entry_point: RTCPeerConnection data channel (RTCSctpTransport receive loop) and SctpUdpTransport UDP encapsulation -> SctpPacket.Parse -> SctpChunk.Parse -> SctpSackChunk.ParseChunk (also public static API)
fix_sites.module_kind: protocol parser (min chunk length for fixed params, fix.diff:21-27)
protocol parser (count vs declared length, fix.diff:36-51)
transport receive loop / exception policy in WebRTC package (fix.diff:64-74)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/SIPSorcery/net/WebRTC/RTCSctpTransport.cs:345-360 (receive loop catch policy in net/WebRTC, not net/SCTP; fix.diff:64)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report is about SACK parsing; once ParseChunk throws ApplicationException the loop already recovers, so changing the WebRTC transport's exception handling looks like an unrelated hardening of another component.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A well-formed SACK whose counts exactly fill its declared length (incl. when located after the 12-byte common header) must still parse; and genuine transport failures (TlsFatalAlert/SocketException, generic fatal errors) must still end the receive loop, so a catch-all would be over-broad.

O6_input_shapes: gap-ack-block count larger than declared chunk (reads leave the array -> IndexOutOfRangeException)
duplicate-TSN count larger than declared chunk
small over-count that stays inside the reused receive buffer (silent stale-byte read, no exception)
non-ApplicationException parse failure from any parser (IndexOutOfRange/ArgumentException) at the receive loop

O8_uncovered_routes.route: INIT/INIT-ACK parser reads 16 bytes of fixed params without checking chunkLen >= 20
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: INIT is handshake-only and the advisory is about SACK

O8_uncovered_routes.route: SHUTDOWN parser reads CumulativeTsnAck with no length check and without ParseFirstWord
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Fixed 4-byte read, 'can only over-read a little'

O8_uncovered_routes.route: DATA parser minimum-length check compares chunkLen to FIXED_PARAMETERS_LENGTH (12) instead of header+fixed (16)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: A length check already exists, so it looks protected

O8_uncovered_routes.route: INIT TLV values parsed without per-type size check: CookiePreservative ParseUInt32 on a null/short value (NullReferenceException is not in the fix's new catch filter, so it still ends the loop), odd-length SupportedAddressTypes, bad-length IPv4/IPv6 address
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: TLV value semantics, a 'different feature' from chunk length validation
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package, sibling file; interacts with WebRTC catch filter at src/SIPSorcery/net/WebRTC/RTCSctpTransport.cs:345-360

O8_uncovered_routes.route: ERROR/ABORT cause values parsed with fixed-width reads on short or odd-length ParameterValue
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Error/abort chunks are diagnostic; the association is ending anyway

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Chunk and TLV header bounds checks compare against buffer.Length (the reused 256 KiB receive buffer) rather than the packet/chunk end, so sub-parsers can read stale bytes past the packet
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: base class + TLV file + WebRTC transport

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A FORWARD-TSN or RE-CONFIG chunk parser with a peer-supplied stream-entry count looping over the buffer
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Both are listed as TODO chunk types (SctpChunk.cs:61-67) and a data-channel stack would add them using the SACK parser as template.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Missing-mandatory-parameter cause carrying an explicit count field driving the loop instead of the value length
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: RFC 4960 defines that cause with a 'Number of missing params' field; the parser currently ignores it.

O9_family: out-of-bounds read / unchecked peer-supplied length in binary protocol parser; unhandled exception kills receive thread

O10_build.toolchain: .NET SDK (multi-target netstandard2.0..net10.0; net8/9/10 test run sufficient), NuGet restore
O10_build.project_tests: test/unit/net/SCTP/SctpChunkUnitTest.cs, SctpPacketUnitTest.cs, SctpAssociationUnitTest.cs (xUnit); parsers are static and testable offline

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add 'if (reportPosn + 4 > buffer.Length) throw' inside the SACK loops: bounds against the array, not the declared chunk length, so in-bounds stale-byte reads and the receive-loop exception policy stay unfixed.
